subject: Civic Education
lesson: Presents information about other public services provided by the government: Public Issue Tree / Cause-Effect Diagram: Competency Level 8.1.2
unique_learning_outcome: Presents information about other public services provided by the government.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: Teacher introduces the topic of public services provided by the government. Students are asked to recall any public services they are familiar with. The teacher then distributes the prompts/cue cards and students inspect the tasks. This leads directly into the selected activity.

post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Students will write a short reflection on what they learned about public services provided by the government and how they can contribute to their community.
selected_activity:
Activity: Public Issue Tree / Cause-Effect Diagram: Competency Level 8.1.2
Approach: Students use public issue tree / cause-effect diagram to explore 'Presents information about other public services provided by the government.'. Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students negotiate a solution, create a shared civic artifact, and review another group's proposal. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A group civic proposal, diagram, or public information message.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
